_note: Test customer type: Nordic online brands on several sales channels. Product lagerlys, pricing tiered (self-serve Basic, sales-led Pro, custom Enterprise). Fictional.
offer: Lagerlys stops stock-outs and overselling by keeping every sales channel and the warehouse on one live stock count.
product_info: Lagerlys is inventory software for brands and wholesalers that sell online and to shops. It syncs stock across Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon and the warehouse in real time, warns before a product sells out, and suggests reorder quantities from the last 90 days of sales. Set up in a day with no IT team.
tone: Plain, short and specific. No hype words and no exclamation marks. One clear ask. Max 120 words for a first email.

auto_close.standard_terms: List price, standard terms, no custom contract

basic.for: One shop, up to 1,000 orders a month

pricing.deal_policy: Enterprise prices are set by a rep. Discounts above 10% need an admin.
